sample-baker/sourdough-chart.README.md:
# Sourdough chart

An interactive chart of bulk fermentation times by dough temperature.

## Usage

    npx sourdough-chart --flour wheat --units c

| Flag | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--flour` | wheat, rye or spelt |
| `--units` | c or f |
| `--starter` | starter percentage (default 20) |

Source is in `src/`: `curves.js` holds the data, `chart.js` draws it.
